The black fire sword, the legalization of illegitimate children, martial names, bloodlines and the ambitions of dissatisfied nobles are intertwined, making the dispute not just a war between two people, but a fight between " The defeated rebels fled into exile across the Narrow Sea, and their descendants and supporters formed exiled military traditions such as the Golden Company. To the nobles of the Seven Kingdoms, the Blackfyre name signifies old dangers; to the exiles, it may also mean the unacknowledged dreams of legitimacy.
